**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback-level cure).**

- **What I found:** Article 14 has no general exit mechanic. Section 14.3 (p0782 ff.) is doubly conditional — it applies only to terminations under Section 14.2 *and* only "if SFJ has not caused a Program Transfer to occur," so expiration is not covered. Its content is assignment of Product Filings/Trial Data Package plus a redacted delivery period, and the only continuation obligation (14.3.4(ii), p0788) is a redacted clinical-trial transfer window, not a stated assistance duration. Section 10.3 (p0640) is a Confidential Information return/destruction clause at the Disclosing Party's direction, with no export deadline.
- **Cure:** one insertion after p0795 creating Section 14.5 — assistance for at least ninety (90) days and export/delivery of our Product and Clinical Trial data within thirty (30) days after any expiration or termination.
- **Deliberately omitted:** then-current rates, machine-readable format and certified deletion are preferred-level elements only; I did not volunteer them, and I did not disturb Sections 14.3, 14.4 or 10.3.
